title: Six public company annual cash-flow statements, FY2025 (evidence revision 2)
coverage: Collection revision 2: Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and NVIDIA consolidated public groups; not all AI companies. No private firms or separately counted subsidiaries. Fiscal periods differ; select one company, never sum them.
convention: Nominal USD millions. Source cash flow = operating cash flow minus the exact reported cash investment item, before dividends and repurchases. Cash outflow magnitudes are positive; evidence retains reported signs. NVIDIA includes intangible purchases in its combined line. Allocation ceiling=max(0, source cash flow).

evidence.statement: Stockholders’ equity statement and cash flow statement
evidence.lineItem: Dividends derived from the complete retained-earnings reconciliation
evidence.locator: Consolidated Statements of Stockholders’ Equity, printed page 40, and Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, printed page 36; FY 2025
evidence.note: Derived, not a separately printed dividend cash-flow line: opening retained earnings 172,866 + net income 77,670 = closing retained earnings 250,536 million USD. The complete audited equity reconciliation has no dividend distribution or other retained-earnings movement; the cash-flow statement has no dividend payment. These statements support an inferred zero distribution.
